notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/3f17dd8e6b6fd56534a8f8364a5353c7a93bb64e.png[/img]

Hello Gunners!

Christmas and the New Year are ahead of us, which means it's time to slow down and reflect. So what was this year like for us? 

Certainly a busy one, we managed to take part in the winter edition of SIMFEST: Hobby Edition, during which our production enjoyed considerable interest among players. We got a lot of useful feedback, which helped us to know your expectations from the Cannon Foundry Simulator. We managed to introduce many interesting ideas, which we regularly informed you about on Steam and social media! May the next year be even more productive for us!

So, returning to the Holidays and the New Year, we'd like to wish you the warmest wishes! [b]Health, joy, and peace for this special time[/b], and may Santa Claus listen to your requests and bring you under the Christmas tree your dream cannon! Also, [b]may 2023 be full of success in your personal and professional life![/b]

Orbital Fireworks

notes.title: Metal Alloying Process
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/d46f37b258164d8aa493fc96c31e5e2c89be67ad.png[/img]

Hello Gunners!

Work in progress - this is how we could describe the last weeks of our work. In the development of our production, in addition to working on elements that appeared in earlier devlogs, we focused on creating a [b]metal alloying process[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/c5cb202986581907fb55498f93c92ad834febbd7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/7fd07e4aecf58b3d18bb3fb10bc7f60a526d5e4b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/086dcc8a01eabddddb8c25494bcb07dd82210171.png[/img]

We started with the idea of pouring the alloy into a mold. The whole process involves placing an oblong mold in the holes that are in the ground so that casting of the cannon can be made. As you can see at the below video, there's a furnace door in the upper right corner. When you lift them up, the melt will flow out of the furnace and fill the molds. Take a look at what the process looks like in the material.

[previewyoutube=0j2nI67O6EM;full][/previewyoutube]
How do you like it? Let us know in the comments and keep watching our Steam and other social media for more!

notes.title: Blast Furnace Bellow
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/1681c00f92ac86dbeabe79363b0e1e2073721436.png[/img]

Hello Gunners!

Another news and another objects to show you from the Cannon Foundry Simulator game. This time we wanted to show you [b]the bellow of a blast furnace with a gearbox[/b].

Let's start with the fact that its task is to create a blow of pressurized air to get a higher temperature and speed up the process of smelting metal alloy. Our blast furnace bellow with gear is modeled after those found in windmills. The mechanism works faster or slower, and that means more or less efficiently. This is influenced by the drive, that is, the waterwheel shaft and its mesh. This element isn't implemented, so we can't show it to you, but work is in progress!

For now, take a look at some screenshots of the blast furnace bellow with a gearbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/0d6323f5804e1c115d2d62df9e4a1d2f86305141.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: SIMFEST: Hobby Edition - Live Stream!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/276c721891d23d474133a1a63f6a61b8adc28d4d.png[/img]

What’s up Gunners? Have you heard of [b]SIMFEST: Hobby Edition[/b], which is currently running on Steam? This is the only such event dedicated to simulator games. The main feature of these games is an attempt to imitate a job or a hobby. Our game that fits perfectly into this convention is Cannon Foundry Simulator.

If you haven't heard of our game yet, then you're setting up a cannon foundry here, where you've to go through the entire process of creating an old cannon from the very beginning.

As part of SIMFEST: Hobby Edition, you'll be able to watch a stream on which we’ll show fragments of our game. Additionally, a chat will be available during the broadcast, where you'll be able to ask questions to our dev. So… are we seeing you on the stream?

The event will last until April 4!

notes.title: Gunners, Season's Greetings!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/6983af43352bef98ce7fbc6f8759252407d66856.png[/img]

Hello, Everyone!

A special time is coming - the time of Christmas and the celebration of the New Year. The passing one was very intense for us, because we devoted every free moment to working on our game Cannon Foundry Simulator. But we don't complain about it, we hope that next year we also have a lot of work ahead of us and that we'll be able to present you even more results.

In the meantime, we'd like to wish you a healthy and peaceful Christmas spent with your loved ones. Cannon as a gift under the tree or in a sock won’t fit, but we can wish you a "boombastic" party on the occasion of the New Year!

[b]Merry Christmas and the Happy New Year![/b]

Orbital Fireworks
